caveat: Physics-model output, not a direct volumetric measurement. Boundary lofts and streamlines are explicitly model-derived two-cut proxies, not recovered 3-D fields. RBE is model-native only at its equatorial coordinates; any off-equator belt is explicitly ideal-dipole mapped. Plane distance is compressed in the globe; colors are consistently quantized across time.
coordinateSystem: GSM for MHD planes; magnetic local time/L shell for RBE

displayModes.smooth: gap-aware local interpolation clamped to contributing source values; cannot introduce new extrema

fieldMaskEncoding.meaning: Missing and range-clipped source values remain distinguishable from valid encoded endpoints.
fieldMaskEncoding.storage: uint8 base64, one bit field per adaptive-grid value

history.archivedFrameEmptyPlanes: Archived frames carry an empty planes object, not cut-plane field data. It is present only because the browser indexes into it unguarded.
history.archivedFrameOmissionReason: The BATS-R-US cut-plane fields are about 70% of a frame and feed only the hidden layer-geospace control. Complete frames including planes are retained on bigmem; they are withheld from the published archive to keep this an on-demand download rather than an 8 MB one.
history.cadenceReason: The published archive is thinned onto a fixed UTC grid to bound the download. The cadence is uniform across the window on purpose: the browser will not bridge a gap wider than 2.5x the median frame spacing, so a mixed dense/sparse sequence would report no data at times that are actually held.
history.method: exact NOAA operational SWMF/RBE frames reduced once when they are current and archived on bigmem; nothing is refetched, reconstructed, or interpolated
history.notUsed: temporal interpolation, stale-frame holding, or any reconstruction of a time NOAA did not publish

model: NOAA operational Geospace SWMF: BATS-R-US + RIM + RCM + RBE

coordinates.meaning: field-line-mapped equatorial crossing radius and magnetic local time from RBE block columns 3 and 4
coordinates.orientation: MLT 0 midnight, 6 dawn, 12 noon (+X GSM), and 18 dusk (+Y GSM)

dipoleMapped3d.label: DIPOLE-MAPPED MODEL VISUALIZATION
dipoleMapped3d.meaning: browser mapping of RBE equatorial pitch-resolved samples along ideal dipole lines, not native 3-D RBE or BATS-R-US output

nativeEquatorial.label: MODEL-NATIVE EQUATORIAL FLUX
nativeEquatorial.meaning: RBE equatorial differential electron flux at the highest published equatorial pitch channel

source.cadence: one-minute upstream output reduced to a 20-minute browser sequence
source.name: NOAA/NCEP NOMADS operational SWMF output

bowShock.derivation: outermost simultaneous density >=1.3x and thermal pressure >=5x upstream with speed <=0.96x upstream; strongest local log-change within the outer transition
bowShock.meaning: model-derived bow-shock proxy, not a directly published discontinuity or full 3-D isosurface
bowShock.representation: raywise transition profiles on y=0 and z=0 cuts; browser loft is constrained to those two sections

magnetopause.derivation: strongest current-density ridge between 0.5 bow-shock radius and 2 RE inside the shock, retained only with an inward density drop
magnetopause.meaning: model-derived magnetopause current-layer proxy; the region between it and the bow-shock proxy is a magnetosheath cue
magnetopause.representation: raywise current-layer profiles on y=0 and z=0 cuts; browser loft may contain unsupported gaps

notExtracted.cusps: The meridional current-layer proxy may show an indentation, but two cuts cannot establish a 3-D cusp surface or reconnection topology, so no cusp is classified.
notExtracted.ringCurrent: The published cuts contain bulk MHD variables, and the RBE file contains energetic electrons on L/MLT coordinates; neither is a species-resolved ring-current distribution.
notExtracted.volumetricTopology: Two orthogonal adaptive-grid cuts cannot recover dawn-dusk structure away from those planes or true 3-D field-line connectivity.

projectedFlowStreamlines.meaning: instantaneous in-plane bulk-flow projections with source-vector speed at every point; model-time advection follows slowing and deflection but is not a Lagrangian time integration

projectedMagneticStreamlines.meaning: instantaneous in-plane magnetic-vector projections, not traced 3-D field lines or magnetic connectivity

streamlineEncoding.flowSpeedStorage: little-endian uint16 base64 aligned one-to-one with projected flow points
streamlineEncoding.storage: little-endian int16 coordinate pairs plus uint16 offsets, base64

time.noDataIntervalBasis: computed by holding each published frame forward for one cadence. The browser instead snaps to the nearer frame, so an interval's width is exact but its placement can differ by up to 60 minutes.
time.selection: snap to the nearer published frame; the radiation belts never interpolate through time, and a missing slot on the published grid is reported as no data
